tracer.lathe.blocked: Lathe needs the space at %s left empty
tracer.lathe.taken: %s at %s is already part of another lathe
tracer.lathe.goggles.title: Lathe
tracer.jei.any_block: Any full block works, not just these
tracer.jei.master: Goes between the tracer holders, needs the tracer row formed. Wins over the template
tracer.jei.template_table: Put a profile template in, drag the bars to set how wide each layer is and hit Save. Sneak-click a turned block with a template to copy its shape instead.
tracer.ponder.lathe_build.text_1: A lathe sits on three lathe beds in a row
tracer.ponder.lathe_build.text_2: Headstock on one end, tailstock on the other. Place them looking along the bed so the headstock ends up on your left
tracer.ponder.lathe_build.text_3: The spot between them has to stay empty. If anything is off, the wrench fails and tells you where
tracer.ponder.lathe_build.text_4: With the middle clear, a wrench on any part puts it together
tracer.ponder.lathe_build.text_5: Rotation goes into the back of the headstock
tracer.ponder.lathe_build.text_6: Breaking any part takes the whole lathe apart again
tracer.ponder.lathe_cutting.text_1: Right-click the lathe with a written profile template
tracer.ponder.lathe_cutting.text_2: Then with the block you want turned. Most full blocks work
tracer.ponder.lathe_cutting.text_3: Give it rotation and the cutter works along the piece, following the template
tracer.ponder.lathe_cutting.text_4: Take the finished piece out with an empty hand. Sneak to take the template back
tracer.ponder.lathe_cutting.text_5: Funnels, hoppers and mechanical arms can feed blocks in and pull pieces out from any lathe part
tracer.ponder.lathe_tracer.header: Copying a Master with the Tracer
tracer.ponder.lathe_tracer.text_1: A tracer row goes two blocks behind the lathe: three rails, a holder over each end, the middle left empty
tracer.ponder.lathe_tracer.text_2: Wrench the lathe again and the tracer joins it
tracer.ponder.lathe_tracer.text_3: Right-click a holder with any turned piece to load it as the master. It wins over the template
tracer.ponder.lathe_tracer.text_4: The stylus rides the master and the cutter copies it, no template needed
tracer.ponder.lathe_tracer.text_5: Pull the master out mid cut and the lathe just waits, keeping its progress until a master or template is back
tracer.ponder.lathe_tracer.text_6: Funnels on the tracer row load masters too
tracer.ponder.template_table.text_1: The template table writes shapes onto profile templates. Put a template in the slot
tracer.ponder.template_table.text_2: Each of the 16 bars is one layer, foot at the left. Drag them to set how wide the piece is there, then hit Save
tracer.ponder.template_table.text_3: Or sneak-click a turned piece with a template to copy its shape
